        From 167bfe534dc2de680ef706dbb903c9a7bfcb2dd8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2018 10:55:17 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] Documentation: drm: Remove dangling pointer from drm-mm.rst
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Fixes htmldocs build error:
Error: Cannot open file ../drivers/gpu/drm/drm_global.c

Fixes: 2bb42410b1bd ("drm: Remove drm_global.{c,h} v2")
Cc: Thomas Zimmermann <tzimmermann@suse.de>
Cc: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Cc: Junwei Zhang <Jerry.Zhang@amd.com>
Cc: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Cc: Maarten Lankhorst <maarten.lankhorst@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Maxime Ripard <maxime.ripard@bootlin.com>
Cc: Sean Paul <sean@poorly.run>
Cc: David Airlie <airlied@linux.ie>
Cc: Christian Koenig <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Cc: Huang Rui <ray.huang@amd.com>
Cc: dri-devel@lists.freedesktop.org
Signed-off-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Dave Airlie <airlied@redhat.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20181129155522.33749-1-sean@poorly.run
---
 Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst | 3 ---
 1 file changed, 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst b/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst
index d0f3c6b03200..54a696d961a7 100644
--- a/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst
+++ b/Documentation/gpu/drm-mm.rst
@@ -79,9 +79,6 @@ count for the TTM, which will call your initialization function.
 
 See the radeon_ttm.c file for an example of usage.
 
-.. kernel-doc:: drivers/gpu/drm/drm_global.c
-   :export:
-
 
 The Graphics Execution Manager (GEM)
 ====================================
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The documentation file `drm-mm.rst` contained a reference to a file `drm_global.c` that was removed in a previous commit (2bb42410b1bd). This led to a build error when generating HTML documentation, as the build process attempted to access a non-existent file, resulting in a dangling pointer in the documentation. The patch removes the reference to the deleted file to resolve the build error.
